review.description: S5 adds hosted push/PR verification using exact event SHAs, one exact reviewed public-root bootstrap without a fabricated diff, and tag-driven promotion of the same verified checksummed main CI artifacts. The original fourteen-flow adoption pin and list are unchanged.
review.implementation: Inspected scripts/ci.py comparison and run_verification plus release.py resolve/deliver and both pinned GitHub Actions workflows. First public import has no publishable ancestor, is SHA-pinned by administrator and receives all fixture checks. Later mismatched or missing comparisons fail. Publisher requires exact main push CI and cannot overwrite existing releases or install services.
review.tests: Read HostedCITests temporary Git histories and failure cases for unknown roots, SHA mismatch, exact PR/push bases, merge bases, fixture environment, wrong workflow or branch provenance, altered bytes, unsafe paths/symlinks and dry-run nonpublication. Existing201specification and20legacy suites remain required, alongside real browser fixtures and packaging tests.
